render_video_360: render a 360 degree orbiting video of a 3D sample with configurable resolution and frame count
render_frames_multi_view: render color and depth frames from a 3D sample given camera extrinsics and intrinsics
convert_camera_params: convert yaw, pitch, radius, and fov values into camera extrinsics and intrinsics matrices
render_multiview_hammersley: render a multi-view set of images from a 3D sample using Hammersley sphere sampling
render_snapshot_four_views: render four orthogonal snapshot views of a 3D sample with configurable offset and resolution
